name: omp-execpolicy
description: Codex-style shell command judgment for oh-my-pi: prefix rules, dangerous-command heuristics, and an optional model judge gating every bash call

enabled.description: Judge shell commands at all. Disabled = the extension loads but never intervenes.

ask.description: 'never' rejects prompt verdicts outright instead of asking (Codex approval_policy=never).

unmatched.description: Verdict for commands no rule matched. 'prompt' holds every unmatched command for approval (the reviewer decides when judge is on). 'none' leaves it to the harness.

judge.description: Ask a model to review every command that needs approval, standing in for the user prompt (Codex auto-review). Off = you answer each prompt yourself.

judgeModel.description: Model for the judge: provider/id, bare id, or a role alias such as @smol.

judgeRetries.description: Extra attempts after an empty or malformed judge response. Provider errors and timeouts are not retried.

judgeOnError.description: When the judge cannot produce a verdict: ask the user, or let the command run.

judgePolicy.description: Security policy for the judge: inline text, or a path to a markdown file.

extraRuleFiles.description: Extra *.rules file to load, or a comma-separated list of them.

amendRules.description: Offer "don't ask again" approvals that append an allow rule to the amendment file.

amendFile.description: Rule file amended when the user approves a command with "don't ask again".
